Those with more than one chamber may have multiple sub-chambers leading off from the main burial chamber.  One common layout, the cruciform passage grave, is cross-shaped. For example, W, a witness, testifies that she saw X drive his automobile into a green car.  Meanwhile, Y, another witness, testifies that when he examined X's car, later that day, he noticed green paint on its fender. It is a strongly typed runtime which allows clients to dictate what data is needed.  This avoids both the problems of over-fetching as well as under-fetching of data.
